proof.target: Remote-safe prompt-dispatch scout demonstrating contract-only translation

Live-delivery mode fails-closed on Linux with BLOCKED_LINUX_WSL_REQUIRED and returns UNIMPLEMENTED on Windows. All tests pass (12 scout tests, protocol and builder tests unchanged). Proof ceiling explicitly SCOUT_CONTRACT_STATIC.
proof.ceiling: SCOUT_CONTRACT_STATIC — proves contract-only translation from routing-decision to prompt-dispatch with fail-closed host blocking. Does NOT prove live FirstMate delivery, Admin Box runtime, crew execution, or dual-path vision complete.
